text:
Rashid: Opening a PR to add iptables-legacy examples and a short section on airgap bundle upload tips (multipart S3, checksums). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3250

Li: Nice. Can you also add SELinux notes (chcon + boolean) for systems with enforcing mode? We saw libs failing to load if the pkcs11 .so isn't accessible.

Rashid: Yup. Planning to include: - iptables-legacy snippet for offline networks - systemd drop-in that sources /etc/redwood/installer.env - example PKCS#11 paths and a note about file perms + chcon

Tanya: Also call out offline bundle upload limits and recommend S3 multipart + sha256 checksum file. We had one customer hit a 600MB tar upload that timed out on older portals.

Infra-bot: Preview build ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood.io/3250 — includes iptables examples and upload guidance.

Rashid: Paste iptables snippet here for quick review:

# iptables-legacy example (egress whitelist)
iptables -N REDWOOD_EGRESS
iptables -A OUTPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 198.51.100.0/24 -j REDIRECT -m comment --comment "telemetry"
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -m owner ! --uid-owner redwood -j REDWOOD_EGRESS
iptables -A REDWOOD_EGRESS -j ACCEPT
iptables -A REDWOOD_EGRESS -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited

Rashid: And systemd drop-in example (place as /etc/systemd/system/redwood-installer.service.d/10-env.conf):

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/redwood/installer.env
# installer.env should contain REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY and REDWOOD_ALLOW_PRIVATE_DNS (or installer flags)

Rashid: PKCS#11 notes to include in docs: common paths: /usr/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so, /opt/hsm/pkcs11/libpkcs11.so, /usr/local/lib/libpkcs11.so. Ensure 0644 and root:root; for SELinux enforcing run: sudo chcon -t textrel_shlib_t /opt/hsm/pkcs11/libpkcs11.so

Li: Suggest adding explicit permission check snippet: `stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /opt/hsm/pkcs11/libpkcs11.so` and a note about systemd PrivateTmp and NoNewPrivileges interfering with module load. Maybe recommend `PrivateTmp=false` in drop-in if customers report load issues.

Tanya: For the offline bundle section — recommend: 1) host vendor HSM libs on your internal package mirror; 2) if you must bundle, split into multipart S3 and include a .sha256 alongside; 3) warn about browser upload UI limits and prefer CLI upload.

Docs-bot: Found one broken link in the KMS section pointing to docs/kms/old-proxy. I'll replace with docs/kms/proxy-config and add a redirect note in the PR.

Rashid: Updated PR with SELinux note + permission check and adjusted wording around the installer flag name (installer v0.9.4 uses --enable-private-dns). Also added a short migration checklist for customers upgrading from older flags.

Li: I can run a smoke install in our gov account tomorrow and validate HSM pkcs11 loads and that the installer honors EnvironmentFile proxy settings.

Tanya: I'll add a short blurb about tarball size in the release notes so support can point customers to it.

Infra-bot: CI passed, staged preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood.io/3250/changes

Li: Smoke test green. Installer boots, pkcs11 endpoints load, SELinux context change allowed the lib to be read, and proxy env from /etc/redwood/installer.env respected by service. No additional open ports observed.

Rashid: Great — merging after Docs-bot final link fix. Thanks!"
